description: Small Community Emergency Response Plan (SCERP) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alaska Department of Military and Veterans Affairs, Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Management. This site presents an approach to emergency management for small communities in Alaska. The output is a customized flip book with essential, community-specific information for responding to a disaster. SCERP Steps include:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, High Winds, Landslides, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
